import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots for pairplot-style visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Iris Dataset: Sepal and Petal Measurements by Species', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Define colors for each species
colors = {'setosa': '#FF6B6B', 'versicolor': '#4ECDC4', 'virginica': '#95E1D3'}
species_list = df['species'].unique()

# Plot 1: Sepal Length vs Sepal Width
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
for species in species_list:
    subset = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax1.scatter(subset['sepal_length'], subset['sepal_width'], 
                label=species.capitalize(), alpha=0.7, s=80, 
                color=colors[species], edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sepal Dimensions', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Species', title_fontsize=10)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# Plot 2: Petal Length vs Petal Width
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
for species in species_list:
    subset = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax2.scatter(subset['petal_length'], subset['petal_width'], 
                label=species.capitalize(), alpha=0.7, s=80, 
                color=colors[species], edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax2.set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Petal Dimensions', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend(title='Species', title_fontsize=10)
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# Plot 3: Box plot of Petal Length by Species
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
df_melted = df[['petal_length', 'species']].copy()
bp = ax3.boxplot([df[df['species'] == species]['petal_length'] for species in species_list],
                  labels=[s.capitalize() for s in species_list],
                  patch_artist=True, widths=0.6)
for patch, species in zip(bp['boxes'], species_list):
    patch.set_facecolor(colors[species])
    patch.set_alpha(0.7)
ax3.set_xlabel('Species', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Petal Length Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--', axis='y')

# Plot 4: Violin plot of Sepal Length by Species
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
parts = ax4.violinplot([df[df['species'] == species]['sepal_length'] for species in species_list],
                       positions=range(len(species_list)), widths=0.7, showmeans=True, showmedians=True)
for i, pc in enumerate(parts['bodies']):
    pc.set_facecolor(colors[species_list[i]])
    pc.set_alpha(0.7)
ax4.set_xticks(range(len(species_list)))
ax4.set_xticklabels([s.capitalize() for s in species_list])
ax4.set_xlabel('Species', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Sepal Length Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--', axis='y')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
